# Independent baseline audit of FREE-X6-MARGINAL-32-20261008

Auditor: EM-DVR-41F848. Session: MCP-84e5caaa95ca486794779330c98ecc25. Authority: DA-2B8D2B82D64B3F7DA323, Source commit 7bf3f7cb2f9c62a4389b5cadda0fdbdc34b2f023. Owner delegated this bounded independent candidate audit. No formal Task, CLAIM, whole-task DR, Working Truth freeze, or Foundation promotion is made.

Input: phase-a-freeze.md, SHA256 88ae2291744448beb32a1151c8e9f5f0a254dcf0f11b109c881241126d0b3b5d. A byte-identical copy is phase-a-freeze.input.md. This baseline was constructed before reading any later author proof, code, report, or Source packet. The frozen packet itself contains a proof plan, so this is independent verification after exposure to that plan, not an independently discovered question or a blind proof-route experiment. I did not construct the candidate or supply proof hints to its author. Independent checker imports only Python's standard library.

## Verdict at the frozen candidate boundary

C1, C2, and C3 are valid within the stated finite integer occupancy model, with the conventional nonempty-box condition n_i >= 1 made explicit for C2. The parity witness is sharp for the stated occupancy-mass and signed-support minima. No domain-internal counterexample was found. This judgment follows from the general proofs below; finite rational matrix checks only supplement them.

Do not promote this to a theorem about physical force balance, universal dynamics, all future operations, unique minimal sufficient state, or a novel general quotient calculus. The unsigned occupancy values are declared mathematical state over native Cells, not signed amplitudes; the signed array is only a comparison witness.

## Native object and observation typing

The state space is finite-support maps f:X6 -> N_0 on the native affine Z^6 torsor after choosing a Cell anchor. This chart does not introduce an ontically privileged origin or a final Cell address. Each M_i sums over one raw spatial coordinate and retains the joint five-coordinate label of the others. A marginal codomain is an observation-index set, never an independent lower-dimensional native world. Zero occupancies and the complete declared box remain part of the model. Six spatial axes remain fixed throughout.

Induction over a subset of coordinate indices below is an auxiliary array argument inside fibers of this fixed X6 carrier. It makes no inference from a separate lower-dimensional native geometry. Static C1/C2 require no time coordinate. C3 uses separately typed ordered operation times 0 and 1; its update is not an empirically established time law. Retaining the graph (source Cell, target Cell, count) makes its provenance explicit.

## General proof of C1, independent of finite enumeration

For a finite integer array indexed by d selected native coordinate positions, assume every deletion sum is zero. For d=1 a nonzero array has total zero and therefore at least two nonzero entries. Suppose the support bound 2^(d-1) holds for d-1 indices. Split the array according to its last index. Each nonzero slice has all deletion sums in its remaining d-1 indices zero, because those original marginal equations retain the last-index value. The deletion equation for the last index says the sum of the slices is identically zero. Consequently there cannot be exactly one nonzero slice. At least two nonzero slices exist, each with at least 2^(d-1) entries. Their supports are disjoint in X6, giving at least 2^d entries. At d=6 this is 64.

All deletion sums zero imply the total signed sum is zero. If P is the sum of positive coefficients and N the absolute sum of negative coefficients, P=N and P+N is at least support size, because every nonzero integer has absolute value at least 1. Thus P=N>=32. For h=f-g, pointwise h_+<=f and h_-<=g, so each occupancy total is >=32 even when f and g overlap.

On the two-level box, h(x)=(-1)^(x_1+...+x_6). Pairing the two values of the summed coordinate makes every deletion marginal zero. The 64 nonzero entries split into 32 of each sign. Taking f=h_+, g=h_- attains both bounds. Sharpness does not by itself classify all minimizers, and the frozen packet does not require such classification.

## General integral proof of C2

Let each n_i be a positive integer. Put V_i=Z^{n_i}, let s_i:V_i->Z be coordinate summation, and K_i=ker(s_i). With b_i=e_{n_i}, s_i(b_i)=1, so V_i=K_i direct_sum Z b_i over the integers, not merely over the rationals. The full array lattice is V=V_1 tensor ... tensor V_6, and M_i is s_i on factor i and identity on the other factors.

Expanding the six integral direct sums decomposes V into 64 labeled summands, where each factor is either K_i or Z b_i. For fixed i, M_i kills exactly the summands choosing K_i at that factor. On the direct sum choosing b_i it is an isomorphism onto the corresponding direct decomposition of the target. In particular, images of different summands cannot cancel. Intersecting all six kernels therefore leaves exactly K_1 tensor ... tensor K_6.

For v=(v_1,...,v_n) with sum zero, put c_j=v_1+...+v_j, 1<=j<n. Then v=sum_j c_j(e_j-e_{j+1}); inspecting successive coordinates gives uniqueness. Hence adjacent differences are a Z-basis of K_i, and tensor products are a Z-basis of the intersection, of rank product_i(n_i-1). This proves integral spanning and independence, including saturation; a rank calculation over Q alone would not do so.

For n_i=1, K_i=0 and the kernel is zero, agreeing with rank zero and the empty basis. If an empty axis of length zero were allowed, the written product formula must not be used without a separate empty-box convention. A box means the full Cartesian product of consecutive native coordinate levels. Arbitrary support subsets, periodic wrapping, masked observations, or an alternative meaning of adjacency require a new statement.

## General proof and exact readout of C3

Write a for the chosen anchor and b=a+E_1. The actual declared map is F(a)=b and F(x)=x for x!=a. Its pushforward adds multiplicities at b. For any comparison array h,

F_*h = h + h(a)(delta_b-delta_a).

For the parity witness h(a)=1. The retained axis-1 occupancy readout R_1 sums over axes 2 through 6. Since R_1(h)=0,

R_1(F_*h)=delta_1-delta_0 != 0.

Thus f after the update has axis-1 counts {0:15,1:17}; g has {0:16,1:16}. This is visible through the original observation language: R_1 factors through any M_j with j!=1 by summing four more labels. The deletion marginal M_1 itself stays equal, while each M_j with j!=1 differs. Therefore equality of the six current marginals is not preserved by every allowed one-step local relocation, and the current marginal quotient cannot compute this future readout.

This is an existence-of-failure statement for one explicitly permitted update and one-step horizon. It does not say every primitive-coordinate operation reveals the difference: a common global translation preserves marginal equality. F is not bijective, and is not represented as one. It is still a valid many-to-one occupancy update with nonnegative multiplicity addition. The provenance graph can be retained while displaying the pushed occupancy. None of this proves a primitive force or a universal microscopic dynamics.

## Independent checks and limits

independent_check.py builds deletion matrices directly from all six-coordinate Cells and computes exact rational row ranks by sparse Fraction elimination. For shapes (1,2,2,2,2,2), (2,2,2,2,2,2), (3,2,2,2,2,2), and (3,3,2,2,2,2), it obtains kernel ranks 0,1,2,4 and matching ranks for explicit adjacent-difference tensors. It verifies all six original parity marginals and all stated post-update readouts. The script completed successfully and saved independent-check-results.json. No author's code was opened, imported, or executed. These finite instances do not establish the general support theorem or integral spanning; the arguments above do.

Dropping integrality kills the mass-32 assertion: scaling f and g by any positive rational epsilon retains all equalities with masses 32 epsilon. This is outside the frozen N_0 domain and explains an essential condition. Dropping one of the six deletion tests also changes the lower bound. Static marginal equality alone is not a certificate of future safety.

## Coverage and novelty boundary

Current connector reads found T6_OPERATION_SAFE_QUOTIENT in enterprise_toolbox_registry.json (Git blob 3889506451091ebcfbf7a58cda6517c4af8c3597) and quotient.composition_safe_collapse in research_method_inventory.json (blob 9289039bc689c638fbef10f9f4489e3793e999f0). The exact current source src/enterprise_math/composition_safe_collapse.py (blob 384d166f642fb65c53fc7f2431f43dc99880693a) states the fiber-constancy criterion for r composed with F to descend through q. It applies on the finite two-state input set {f,g}, with q the six deletion observations and r=R_1 after the declared update. q(f)=q(g) and r(F_*f)!=r(F_*g) are precisely its negative witness.

Reuse resolution for that criterion: REUSE_APPLIED, mathematical interface only; no repository executable is claimed to have run for the audit. The independent arithmetic checker is a bounded evidence checker, not a new general tool. A local coverage router was also actually run from workspace commit 9800fa40569c9541ffa8f0c917050cfb067418a3; its broader lexical matches are discovery aids, not current source authority or proof. Current connector registry and exact source reads above control the resolved match.

C1/C2 are elementary integer-array/tensor arguments. This audit establishes their mathematics directly but does not perform an exhaustive historical literature search and does not certify newness. C3 belongs to the existing operation-safe quotient framework. Provisional method harvest is RESULT_ONLY: a sharp scoped witness and integral kernel description, not GLOBAL_TOOL_FAMILY. Any claim of first discovery or novel universal mechanism remains unsupported.

## Remaining unit and parent boundary

This file freezes the auditor's initial proof and tests before the author's complete report. The remaining assigned unit is to compare the author's immutable Source proof/code packet against this baseline, review actual deviations, and publish the final incremental audit with exact readback. Owner decides integration. Completion of this audit does not close the open parent research objective and is not a user stop request.

# Final incremental mathematical audit

Candidate: FREE-X6-MARGINAL-32-20261008. Author: EM-FREE-1956D3. Auditor: EM-DVR-41F848, separate service session MCP-84e5caaa95ca486794779330c98ecc25, ACTIVE DA-2B8D2B82D64B3F7DA323 at verified Source commit 7bf3f7cb2f9c62a4389b5cadda0fdbdc34b2f023. This is the Owner-authorized bounded candidate audit, not a formal whole-Task DR or a canonical mathematical promotion.

## Decision and immutable targets

PASS_SCOPED_MATHEMATICS for C1, C2, C3 and the explicitly post-freeze equality-rigidity corollary. Preserve DERIVED_NOT_AXIOM / EXACT_NEGATIVE_OBSTRUCTION classification, with RESULT_ONLY method harvest and T6 reuse. No new general tool family or research successor is justified by these proofs alone. Owner decides intake and integration; the parent mathematical objective remains OPEN.

The Phase A target is SHA256 88ae2291744448beb32a1151c8e9f5f0a254dcf0f11b109c881241126d0b3b5d. Its byte-identical copy was independently checked before review. The subsequent frozen Source packet was read through the GitHub connector at commit 54097805d55c20cd9caec0dc351e11c60c798284, path research_notes/FREE_X6_MARGINAL_32_20261008.json, Git blob 4989d8ccc8278adaff8f542093e1a410152269b8, SHA256 ba2bf5f0d0e568ebacd2d7d6f517d95d3d1fe7c8ef3de736accc8633df5451cf. Every embedded file hash matches its exact embedded content. The Phase A bytes remain unchanged. Its mathematical report is proof-and-phase-b.md, SHA256 ddbb6dcb47d6f168a2eeb8260d0df17a6f26f8cd50b23cff15050b36dc527db9.

Before reading that complete author packet, the auditor froze independent-audit-baseline.md at SHA256 fb9a660eb38480dc6781ac6ebe4c6265bf0461d52573fc437740e27c996d4462, independent_check.py at b2310689b50d8536e5d0a8d695780a562ac42326cc862ee41abf7e13f5ee27bf, and independent-check-results.json at acf29651897e415c37d2159cc0540266d545ebff32cd03afa76c261724107a2e. The baseline contains complete independent general proofs of C1-C3 and exact typing/reuse boundaries. It is included with this audit and is not replaced by the incremental review.

## Delta review

The complete author proof agrees with the independently established induction, integral direct-sum/tensor argument, and direct pushforward calculation. It explicitly states n_i>=1 and handles n_i=1. This resolves the conventional box-domain qualification. It correctly distinguishes an integral lattice basis from a Markov basis of legal nonnegative moves. No stronger Markov-basis, global minimal-repair, force-law, or universal-dynamics result is established.

New equality-rigidity claim: if a nonzero array in the all-deletion kernel has support exactly 2^d, then it is a nonzero integer multiple of a two-level alternating tensor. Independent verification: for d=1, exactly two nonzero coefficients with zero sum are a and -a. For d>1, each nonzero last-coordinate slice has support at least 2^(d-1). Equality permits exactly two slices, each at its lower bound. Their pointwise sum is zero, so they have identical support and opposite coefficients. Apply the inductive equality characterization to one slice and append the final factor delta_u-delta_v. This yields a tensor with the same scalar a, and proves the converse directly. This is an array induction inside the fixed X6 ambient carrier, not an ontological dimensional induction.

For P=N=32 in X6, 64=2P=sum|h|>=support(h)>=64. Both inequalities are equalities, so support is 64 and every coefficient has absolute value one. Thus |a|=1. Write f=h_++c and g=h_-+c with c=min(f,g)>=0 pointwise. If both total occupancies are 32, sum c=0; hence c=0 and f,g are exactly the parity halves. Levels can be nonadjacent. The local relocation witness uses the particular adjacent levels stated in C3; arbitrary level separation is not silently retyped as one primitive adjacency.

The auditor's additional rigidity_check.py uses only the standard library and the auditor's own frozen checker. It checks all 624 nonzero coefficient choices from {-2,-1,0,1,2}^4 in the 3x3x2^4 kernel: 36 have support 64 and all are scalar alternating two-level boxes; 18 have positive/negative mass 32 and all have unit coefficients. Other support sizes are 96,112,128,144, so the check does not identify arbitrary kernel elements with a single parity tensor. These finite results corroborate the equality cases; the preceding general argument is the proof.

## Scope, independence, and provenance qualification

No author code was imported or executed by the auditor. After freezing the auditor's own code/proofs, the author certificate and saved result were inspected as evidence. The overlapping finite ranks and update outputs were reproduced by the auditor's independent implementation. The author reports T6 execution; the auditor claims only its own direct calculations and mathematical REUSE_APPLIED of the existing fiber-constancy criterion. A new reviewer ID by itself is not the independence argument: the actual separation is no candidate construction, no feedback of proof hints, no author WIP reads, and the pre-packet auditor freeze.

The author report says an attached source-observations.json holds actual connector responses, but that filename is absent from the nine embedded files of the original fixed packet. The auditor reported this non-mathematical attachment omission to Owner. The author subsequently supplied a separate immutable supplement: research_notes/FREE_X6_MARGINAL_32_20261008_SOURCE_OBSERVATIONS.json at 2c15aee472d8ed43509ce89217a535d8be0a6c9b, Git blob 061dc42cd8b7d3a76368aa892527308156d58333, SHA256 3259ed6ebd3f6889ace3c54d0b3ec52101bad64e552169209cf059dab07ca803. The auditor fetched it through the connector and verified its full hash, all eight foundation response hashes against the manifest, and all five Phase B response Git blobs from exact content. It also contains the FREE session rejection and initial activity response, plus three empty-result search responses. This supplementary link repairs the attachment ambiguity; it was not embedded in the original packet. These stored responses do not independently platform-attest all historical exposure times. The report's additional 'marginal' and 'tomography' searches are not among the three stored search receipts and are not independently verified here. No conclusion of exhaustive absence or novelty relies on these searches. The mathematical decision is unaffected.

Source storage, valid hashes, identity registration and successful transport establish provenance and delivery, not mathematical correctness. The mathematical acceptance here is confined to the proved finite-integer occupancy statements. Integer mass, finite support, all six joint deletion marginals, explicit update language and separately typed time are essential. The native six-dimensional Cell model is retained; no native plane, physical negative mass, final-address codec, or additional spatial axis is introduced. External novelty and exhaustive repository dedup are not certified. T6 already supplies the general no-descent principle.

## Handoff boundary

The assigned mathematical audit and its independent tests are complete. Its Source publication and exact readback must accompany the report. This is an internal review handoff, not a user request to stop, and not completion of the open parent research objective. No formal Task/CLAIM/Result/whole-Task review was invented. Owner retains the intake decision and any separate provenance repair or future research work.

rigidity_check.py.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Additional finite corroboration of the post-freeze rigidity claim.

All arrays remain on six-coordinate Cells. Uses only standard library and
the auditor's already frozen own checker; no author code is imported.
"""
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
import json
from pathlib import Path
from independent_check import deletion

shape = (3,3,2,2,2,2)
indices = list(product(range(2),range(2)))
minimal_support = []
mass_minimal = []
support_spectrum = Counter()
for coefficients in product(range(-2,3), repeat=4):
    if not any(coefficients):
        continue
    array = Counter()
    for (a,b),weight in zip(indices,coefficients):
        if not weight:
            continue
        for bits in product((0,1),repeat=6):
            cell=(a+bits[0],b+bits[1],*bits[2:])
            array[cell] += weight * (-1)**sum(bits)
    array={cell:value for cell,value in array.items() if value}
    assert all(not deletion(array,i) for i in range(6))
    support_spectrum[len(array)] += 1
    assert len(array)>=64
    positive=sum(value for value in array.values() if value>0)
    negative=-sum(value for value in array.values() if value<0)
    assert positive==negative and positive>=32
    if len(array)==64:
        levels=[sorted({cell[i] for cell in array}) for i in range(6)]
        assert all(len(level)==2 for level in levels)
        anchor=tuple(level[0] for level in levels)
        scale=array[anchor]
        for bits in product((0,1),repeat=6):
            cell=tuple(levels[i][bits[i]] for i in range(6))
            assert array[cell]==scale*(-1)**sum(bits)
        minimal_support.append(coefficients)
    if positive==32:
        assert len(array)==64 and all(abs(value)==1 for value in array.values())
        mass_minimal.append(coefficients)
out={"scope":"finite corroboration only; general rigidity established by induction",
     "shape":shape,"coefficient_range":[-2,-1,0,1,2],"nonzero_arrays_checked":sum(support_spectrum.values()),
     "support_spectrum":dict(sorted(support_spectrum.items())),
     "minimal_support_arrays":len(minimal_support),"minimal_mass_arrays":len(mass_minimal),
     "all_minimal_support_arrays_are_scalar_two_level_parity":True,
     "all_minimal_mass_arrays_have_unit_coefficients":True,"author_imports":False}
Path(__file__).with_name("rigidity-check-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
